overview: The Warped Courtyards are the broken exterior plazas of Grieg’s fortress.
details: Grieg’s madness shattered the courtyards into floating debris fields and inverted walkways. Psychic storms sweep across the plazas, warping constructs and spawning phantoms.
hooks: A gravity well forms, pulling debris into a vortex.
A psychic storm sweeps across the courtyard.
The Courtyard Parallax manifests to stabilize the distortions.
